name: Chicken Shawarma Bowls with Garlic Yogurt
steps: Marinate the chicken in spices, garlic, lemon and oil and roast at 425°F for 20 minutes; slice.
Stir the yogurt with garlic and lemon.
Serve over quinoa with cucumber, tomato and parsley.

name: Lamb Kofta with Tahini Sauce
steps: Mix the lamb with parsley, onion and spices and shape on skewers.
Grill 10 to 12 minutes.
Whisk the tahini with lemon and a little water and serve with cucumber and tomato.

name: Shakshuka-Style Baked Eggs with Chickpeas and Spinach
steps: Soften the onion in oil with the spices and harissa.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer 8 minutes with the spinach.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook until set.

name: Mujaddara-Style Lentils and Rice with Caramelized Onions
steps: Cook the onions slowly in oil until deep golden.
Combine the cooked lentils and rice with half the onions and the cumin.
Top with the rest of the onions and serve with yogurt and parsley.

name: Chicken and Chickpea Tagine
steps: Brown the chicken, then soften the onion and garlic with the spices.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas and olives and simmer covered 35 minutes.
Finish with cilantro.

name: Stuffed Grape-Leaf-Style Cabbage with Rice and Herbs
steps: Blanch the cabbage leaves.
Mix the rice, herbs, onion, lemon and paste; roll in the leaves.
Pack in a pot with oil and water and simmer 35 minutes.

name: Greek Lemon Chicken Soup (Avgolemono)
steps: Simmer the chicken in the broth; shred it and cook the rice in the broth.
Whisk the eggs with lemon and temper with hot broth.
Stir back in off the heat and add dill.

name: Spanakopita-Style Spinach and Feta Egg Bake
steps: Sauté the onion, garlic and spinach in oil.
Mix with the eggs, feta and dill and pour into a dish.
Bake at 375°F for 28 to 30 minutes.

name: Greek Chicken Souvlaki Plate with Lemon Potatoes
steps: Marinate the chicken in lemon, oregano, garlic and oil; skewer and grill.
Roast the potatoes in lemon and oil.
Serve with cucumber yogurt.

name: Moussaka-Style Eggplant and Turkey Bake
steps: Roast the sliced eggplant.
Brown the turkey with onion, garlic and cinnamon and add the tomatoes.
Layer with the eggplant and top with yogurt whisked with egg and parmesan.
Bake at 375°F for 35 minutes.

name: Jamaican Jerk Chicken with Pineapple Slaw
steps: Blend the spices, garlic, ginger, lime and soy sauce and coat the chicken.
Roast at 425°F for 30 to 35 minutes.
Toss the cabbage with pineapple, lime and cilantro.

name: Caribbean Rice and Peas with Coconut
steps: Simmer the beans with the garlic, thyme and coconut milk.
Fold in the cooked rice and green onion and heat through.

name: Cuban Black Beans and Rice Bowls
steps: Soften the onion, pepper and garlic in oil with the spices.
Add the beans and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve over rice with lime and cilantro.

name: Ropa Vieja-Style Shredded Beef
steps: Simmer the beef in water until tender and shred.
Cook the onion, pepper and garlic in the sauce with spices.
Add the beef and olives and serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Peruvian-Style Roasted Chicken with Green Sauce
steps: Rub the chicken with spices, garlic, lime and oil and roast at 425°F for 40 minutes.
Blend the cilantro, jalapeno, yogurt and a little lime into a green sauce.

name: Argentinian Beef Empanada Filling Bowls
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and spices.
Fold in the chopped olives and sliced boiled egg.
Serve over rice.

name: Brazilian Feijoada-Style Black Bean Stew
steps: Brown the sausage and pork with the onion and garlic.
Add the beans, bay, broth and orange and simmer 45 minutes.
Serve with sautéed collards.

name: Cuban Picadillo over Cauliflower Rice
steps: Brown the beef with the onion, pepper and garlic.
Add the sauce, olives, capers and cumin and simmer 12 minutes.
Serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Moroccan Chickpea and Carrot Salad
steps: Grate the carrots and toss with chickpeas, lemon, oil, cumin and harissa.
Top with parsley and feta.

name: Baba Ganoush with Vegetable Sticks
steps: Roast the eggplant until collapsed, scoop out the flesh.
Blend with tahini, lemon, garlic and oil.
Serve with the vegetable sticks.

name: Za'atar Roasted Chicken with Cauliflower
steps: Toss the chicken and cauliflower with oil, za'atar and salt.
Roast at 425°F for 35 minutes.
Serve with lemon yogurt.

name: Turkish-Style Red Lentil Soup
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in oil with the spices.
Add the lentils and broth and simmer 22 minutes.
Blend and finish with lemon.
